g.text: • Available count, live leases, per-user quantity
• Three Lua scripts: admit, confirm, remaining
• One live lease per customer, expires in 10s
• Enforces maxPerUser on a locked allocation row
• Decrements stock only while it is above zero
• Correct on its own, with or without Redis
